name: Patsch
kurzbeschreibung: Municipality in the district of Innsbruck-Land, located about 6.7 km south of Innsbruck at the foot of the Patscherkofel.
beschreibung:
Patsch is a municipality in the district of Innsbruck-Land, about 6.7 kilometres south of Innsbruck at the foot of the Patscherkofel. Situated in an elevated spot with fine views, the village is one of the oldest in the southern Mittelgebirge landscape and was first mentioned in documents around 1200 as "Patsche".

A sight worth seeing is the Parish Church of St. Donatus. Together with Ampass, Patsch is an ancient parish of Wilten Abbey and one of the oldest parishes in Tyrol; for Ellbögen, Igls, Vill, Lans and Sistrans the village served as the mother parish for a long time.

Even today, farmhouses, agriculture and the proximity to the provincial capital shape village life with around 1,000 inhabitants. The sunny location in the Mittelgebirge offers hiking trails with views of the Inn Valley, the Nordkette and the Stubai Alps.
